stories.headline: Nawrocki vetoes judicial council reform, proposes alternative legislation threatening judges
stories.summary: President Karol Nawrocki vetoed the KRS reform bill that would have restored judge selection of judicial council members, instead proposing his own legislation that would penalize judges for questioning state institutions or neo-judges. Opposition calls it 'judicial gag law.'

stories.headline: Polish military bans Chinese vehicles from entering military installations
